changelog:
- Viewport Insets & Webpage View: Fixed layout logic so the docked command card never hides webpage headers or bottom navigation, ensuring full viewport visibility whether positioned top or bottom.
- Smooth Webpage Expansion on Collapse: Added smooth synchronized margin animations so webpages expand smoothly to fill full screen when the command card collapses on scroll, and contract cleanly when it expands.
- Incognito / Private Home Page Dark Alignment: Fixed incognito home page styling to remain in pure stealth dark theme even when light theme is active across the browser.
